name: io.github.itzhouq/archery-mcp
title: Archery MCP
description: Read-only MCP server for the Archery SQL audit platform: production schema and release SQL checks

environmentVariables.name: ARCHERY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Archery deployment, e.g. https://archery.example.com

environmentVariables.name: ARCHERY_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Archery account username (use a dedicated least-privilege account)

environmentVariables.name: ARCHERY_TOTP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Base32 TOTP secret if the account enables Google Authenticator 2FA

environmentVariables.name: ARCHERY_INSTANCE_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Archery instance name to lock the server to

environmentVariables.name: ARCHERY_DB_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Database name to lock the server to

environmentVariables.name: ARCHERY_SCHEMA_NAME
environmentVariables.description: Schema name (PostgreSQL usually 'public'; leave empty for MySQL)

environmentVariables.name: ARCHERY_QUERY_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Default row limit when the query tool is called without limit; 0 delegates the max to Archery
